formation_states.formation: A battlefield position containing a Force. A Bond and/or Name may also be present.
formation_states.bonded: A Formation containing a Force and a Bond. It may also contain a Name.
formation_states.named: A Formation containing Force + Bond + Name. Every Named Formation is also Bonded.
formation_states.formation_with_name: A Formation containing a Force and a Name but no Bond. It is not Named.
formation_states.prepared_bond: A Bond in a battlefield position with no Force.
formation_states.prepared_name: A Name in a battlefield position with no Force.
formation_states.becomes_named: A Formation becomes Named whenever it changes from not having Force + Bond + Name to having all three. BECOMES NAMED resolves at that transition.
formation_states.bonded_state: BONDED is a state, not a trigger: it is true while a Formation contains Force + Bond.
formation_states.named_state: WHILE NAMED is a state, not a trigger: it is true while a Formation contains Force + Bond + Name.

force.role: Base Strength and at most one short battlefield identity, usually positional, reactive, or exhaustion-related.
force.buried_rule: PLAY text may be covered after it resolves. Persistent Force text and repeatable ACTION text must fit completely in the exposed strip. Regular Forces do not use once-per-Battle abilities; ACTION is a real repeatable choice paid for with an Action and any printed Command cost.

bond.role: Compact relationship/support text between formations; positional Bonds should stay one short line.
bond.buried_rule: PLAY text may be covered after it resolves. All remaining Bond text must be a short state effect completely readable in the exposed strip. Bonds do not carry ACTION or REACTION abilities.

name.role: The readable top card and main home for persistent, recurring, and formation-completion mechanics.

hero.role: Dual-use Force/Name. Force mode obeys Force grammar; Name mode obeys Name grammar.

stratagem.role: A hidden reversal or trap, ordinarily protecting your side or changing an enemy move when revealed.

narrative.role: Face-up battlefield support, strange geography, exceptional exchanges and one-per-Battle decisions.

order.role: Immediate self-support instruction. Playing it consumes the normal card-play Action; it resolves and is discarded.
order.zero_cost_rule: A 0-Command Order must have a real board, class, positional, or state requirement. Unrestricted 0-Command Orders are not allowed.

classification_vocabulary.human: Broadest people classification. Human support is common but deliberately modest.
classification_vocabulary.ship: Long-range support and unusual Front interaction.
classification_vocabulary.stronghold: Static support, protection, and staying power.
classification_vocabulary.archer: Pressure opposing Forces behind open Front rows; punish exposed support.
classification_vocabulary.guard: Prevent flanking and defend the line directly ahead or behind.
classification_vocabulary.scout: Reveal plans and create openings or precision disruption.
classification_vocabulary.rider: Exploit and close gaps by movement before flanking is checked.
classification_vocabulary.skirmisher: Harassment, temporary suppression, and pressure against already Exhausted enemies.
classification_vocabulary.raider: Attack Exhausted Forces, prepared components, and unsupported Middle/Rear formations.
classification_vocabulary.healer: Remove Exhaustion and recover temporary adverse states.
classification_vocabulary.spearman: Simple, dependable battlefield Strength, especially in the Front.
classification_vocabulary.king: Command, broad coordination, and high-impact Named payoffs.
classification_vocabulary.captain: Local formation-building, Bonds, Names, and action efficiency.
classification_vocabulary.veteran: Reliability, marker removal, and once-per-Battle resilience.
classification_vocabulary.steward: Organize prepared Bonds and Names and maintain the second line.
classification_vocabulary.builder: Bonds, prepared cards, and Stronghold-style development.
classification_vocabulary.heir: Succession and access to King synergies once fully established.

classification_rule: Classifications have no inherent rules. Their identity emerges only because other cards consistently refer to them.

memory_vocabulary.effect_marker: Marks a temporary effect on a formation/card.
memory_vocabulary.suppression_marker: Marks text or Strength that is ignored temporarily.
memory_vocabulary.front_marker: Marks a temporary rule attached to a Front.
memory_vocabulary.face_down_source: The face-down Stratagem itself is the reminder.
memory_vocabulary.face_up_source: The visible Narrative/Name itself is the reminder.

layout_spec.no_lifting_rule: A Named Formation must be fully playable without lifting, sliding, or fanning any card.
layout_spec.command_cost: One unlabeled faceted Command-cost gem in the bottom-right corner. The number is the complete visible cost treatment.

playtest_axes.note: Classification is only one axis. These overlapping design tags exist to expose mechanical coverage and help build deliberately varied playtest decks.

timing_vocabulary.play: Resolve immediately when the card is played.
timing_vocabulary.action: Spend one Action to use this ability.
timing_vocabulary.reaction: Use when the stated event occurs; if limited, the player chooses whether to spend the use.
timing_vocabulary.bonded: A state effect active while the Formation contains Force + Bond.
timing_vocabulary.while_named: A state effect active while the Formation contains Force + Bond + Name.
timing_vocabulary.becomes_named: Resolve when the Formation transitions into the Named state.
timing_vocabulary.trigger: A visible Name reacts to the stated event.
timing_vocabulary.continuous: A visible Name or Narrative rule remains active while its source remains active.
timing_vocabulary.hidden: A face-down Stratagem reveals under its stated condition.
timing_vocabulary.front: A state effect active while the formation is in the Front row.
timing_vocabulary.middle: A state effect active while the formation is in the Middle row.
timing_vocabulary.rear: A state effect active while the formation is in the Rear row.
timing_vocabulary.exhausted: A state effect active while this Force has an Exhaustion token.
timing_vocabulary.tireless: A persistent Force ability that ignores only the Exhaustion restriction on initiating a Maneuver; every other Maneuver requirement still applies and Exhaustion remains.
timing_vocabulary.mobile: A persistent Force ability allowing it to initiate a Maneuver without being Named; other Maneuver requirements still apply.

position_vocabulary.directly_ahead: The adjacent position in the same Front one rank toward the Front row. A Front-row formation has no position directly ahead.
position_vocabulary.directly_behind: The adjacent position in the same Front one rank toward the Rear row. A Rear-row formation has no position directly behind.
position_vocabulary.row_restriction: An allowed-row restriction is a hard occupancy restriction: the Force may be played only in those ranks and may not Maneuver, Move, or Swap into a forbidden rank.
position_vocabulary.move: MOVE 1 means move the formation to one orthogonally adjacent active empty position: one Front left or right in the same rank, or one rank forward or backward in the same Front. Never diagonal. Move is a card effect, not a Maneuver, so it does not require Named status, costs no Maneuver Command, and Exhaustion does not stop it.
position_vocabulary.move_multiple: Move up to N positions means make up to N legal one-position Moves, one at a time; every intermediate destination must be legal and empty.
position_vocabulary.swap: SWAP means exchange the complete contents of the two specified friendly positions. Both positions must contain a formation unless the card says otherwise. Swap is a card effect, not a Maneuver, costs no Maneuver Command, and Exhaustion does not stop it.
position_vocabulary.movement_event: A formation moves whenever it changes battlefield position by Maneuver, Move, or Swap, regardless of which player or effect caused the relocation.
position_vocabulary.support: SUPPORT +N means the friendly formation directly ahead has +N Strength while the supporting effect is active.
position_vocabulary.supply: SUPPLY means Bonds played onto the friendly formation directly ahead cost 1 less Command, to a minimum of 0, and Names played onto it cost 1 less Command, to a minimum of 1.
position_vocabulary.outmatched: A formation is OUTMATCHED while an opposing formation occupies the same rank in the same Front and has greater current Strength after continuous Strength modifiers are applied. A tie is not OUTMATCHED. This local comparison does not itself decide the Front.
position_vocabulary.reserve: RESERVE +N means this formation has +N Strength while the friendly formation directly ahead is OUTMATCHED.
position_vocabulary.tireless: TIRELESS means this Force may initiate a Maneuver while Exhausted. It ignores only the Exhaustion restriction; every other Maneuver requirement still applies. It keeps its Exhaustion token. TIRELESS is boolean, so multiple sources give no additional benefit.
position_vocabulary.exhaustion: After you lose a Front, every Force you have in that Front receives one Exhaustion token, to a maximum of one. Exhaustion persists between Battles, moves with the Force, and normally prevents that Force from initiating a Maneuver. If the Force leaves the battlefield, its token leaves with it. A tied Front exhausts neither player.
position_vocabulary.stacking: Multiple active SUPPORT +N, RESERVE +N, and PRESS +N effects add together. Multiple active SUPPLY effects each reduce the cost by 1; SUPPLY may reduce Bonds to 0 Command but may not reduce Names below 1.
position_vocabulary.command_modifiers: Command modifiers stack: add all applicable increases, then apply all applicable reductions. If any applicable reduction explicitly allows minimum 0, the final reduced cost may reach 0; otherwise reductions cannot take a positive printed cost below 1 unless a card explicitly says otherwise.
position_vocabulary.tax_markers: Each Tax marker is separate. If the next card played satisfies multiple Tax markers, all matching increases apply and all matching next-card markers are consumed. A marker with an expiry expires when its own text says it does.
position_vocabulary.strength_marker: A -Strength marker is a temporary negative marker recording a Battle-long Strength penalty created by card text such as gets -2 Strength this Battle.
position_vocabulary.temporary_negative_marker: A temporary negative marker is any adverse marker on a formation created by a finite-duration card effect, including -Strength, text-suppression, or ability-lock markers. It does not include Exhaustion or a Tax marker on a Front. Removing one ends that marker's effect.
position_vocabulary.directly_opposite: The position in the same rank and same Front on the opposing player's side.
position_vocabulary.mobile: MOBILE means this Force may initiate a Maneuver without being Named. It ignores only the Named requirement: Command cost, adjacency, legal destination, row restrictions, and Exhaustion still apply.
position_vocabulary.press: PRESS +N means this formation has +N Strength while at least one opposing Force in this Front is Exhausted. Multiple active PRESS bonuses add together.
position_vocabulary.supply_raid: A formation provides SUPPLY only while an active, unsuppressed SUPPLY effect on that formation is live. Cards that raid Supply state their own payoff; raiding does not remove SUPPLY unless a card says so.
position_vocabulary.steal_command: STEAL N COMMAND means your opponent loses up to N Command, but not below 1; you regain exactly the amount actually lost. Stealing Command does not itself cause Collapse during a Battle.
